# Funding — public posture only

**Updated:** 17 September 2026  
**Claim tier:** posture only. Pre-seed.

Grant discovery, opportunity boards, fit scores, investor matrices, install matrices, and application drafts are **commercial-track / private**.

Public GitHub does not publish:
- live opportunity pipelines or dollar figures
- private repository inventories
- internal skill catalogues or local clone paths
- scored packs, prices, or partner approaches

Coastal Alpine Tech Limited pursues non-dilutive grants and paid pilots as the primary pre-seed path. No application is submitted without human approval.

See the public landing [`README.md`](../../README.md) and [`SAFE_NZ_AI.md`](../../SAFE_NZ_AI.md).
